newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.250 cent. Better than expected cash markets and spillover from pork pits.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.250 cent. Rising CME feeder index and lower feed costs.
LEAN HOGS - up 0.750 to 2.000 cent limit. Carryover from hog report which showed slower than expected herd expansion. Cash hogs higher and pork cutouts up.
PORK BELLIES - up 1.500 to 3.000 cent limit. Carryover buy stops after report and higher cash prices.
